examples.hanzi: 这件事我们某种程度上都有责任。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒmen mǒu zhǒng chéngdù shàng dōu yǒu zérèn.
examples.english: To some extent we are all responsible for this.

examples.pinyin: Tā hǎoxiàng déle mǒu zhǒng bìng.
examples.english: He seems to have some kind of illness.

examples.hanzi: 这首歌是我美好的记忆。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē shì wǒ měihǎo de jìyì.
examples.english: This song is a fond memory of mine.

examples.hanzi: 我的记忆力不好，常常忘事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de jìyìlì bù hǎo, chángcháng wàngshì.
examples.english: My memory isn't good and I often forget things.

examples.hanzi: 这个乐队的主唱声音很好听。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge yuèduì de zhǔchàng shēngyīn hěn hǎotīng.
examples.english: This band's lead singer has a lovely voice.

examples.hanzi: 我弟弟想加入学校的乐队。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi xiǎng jiārù xuéxiào de yuèduì.
examples.english: My younger brother wants to join the school band.

examples.hanzi: 这件事很紧急，请马上处理。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hěn jǐnjí, qǐng mǎshàng chǔlǐ.
examples.english: This matter is urgent, please handle it right away.

examples.hanzi: 医院每天都有紧急的病人。
examples.pinyin: Yīyuàn měi tiān dōu yǒu jǐnjí de bìngrén.
examples.english: The hospital has emergency patients every day.

examples.pinyin: Tā míngnián yào shàng gāozhōng le.
examples.english: He will start senior high school next year.

examples.hanzi: 我们高中同学每年都聚一次。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gāozhōng tóngxué měi nián dōu jù yí cì.
examples.english: My high school classmates get together once every year.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān tīngting dàjiā de yìjiàn.
examples.english: First listen to everyone's opinions.

examples.hanzi: 你听听，外面是不是下雨了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīngting, wàimiàn shì bu shì xià yǔ le?
examples.english: Listen, is it raining outside?

examples.hanzi: 你来得正好，我们正要吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lái de zhènghǎo, wǒmen zhèng yào chīfàn.
examples.english: You came just in time, we're about to eat.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié de dàxiǎo zhènghǎo.
examples.english: The size of these shoes is just right.

examples.pinyin: Tā háowú bànfǎ, zhǐhǎo děngzhe.
examples.english: He had no way out and could only wait.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xiǎngfǎ háowú yìyì.
examples.english: This idea is completely meaningless.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng tíxǐng wǒ míngtiān kāihuì.
examples.english: Please remind me of tomorrow's meeting.

examples.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā yào shǎo chī yán.
examples.english: The doctor reminded him to eat less salt.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan yí ge rén lǚxíng.
examples.english: I like traveling alone.

examples.hanzi: 这次旅行我们玩得很开心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng wǒmen wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: We had a great time on this trip.

examples.hanzi: 朋友们给我准备了一个惊喜。
examples.pinyin: Péngyoumen gěi wǒ zhǔnbèile yí ge jīngxǐ.
examples.english: My friends prepared a surprise for me.

examples.hanzi: 看到她突然回来，我又惊喜又感动。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào tā tūrán huílái, wǒ yòu jīngxǐ yòu gǎndòng.
examples.english: Seeing her suddenly return, I was pleasantly surprised and moved.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ názǒu zhuō shàng de shū.
examples.english: You can take the books off the table.

examples.hanzi: 别人没有把我的伞拿走吧？
examples.pinyin: Biéren méiyǒu bǎ wǒ de sǎn názǒu ba?
examples.english: Surely no one has taken my umbrella?

examples.hanzi: 春节接近了，街上很热闹。
examples.pinyin: Chūnjié jiējìn le, jiē shang hěn rènao.
examples.english: The Spring Festival is approaching and the streets are lively.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen de xiǎngfǎ hěn jiējìn.
examples.english: Their ideas are very close.

examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá dàibǔle nà ge xiǎotōu.
examples.english: The police arrested the thief.

examples.hanzi: 他因为偷东西被逮捕了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi tōu dōngxi bèi dàibǔ le.
examples.english: He was arrested for stealing.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā pángbiān yǒu yì jiā chāoshì.
examples.english: There is a supermarket next to my home.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zuò zài wǒ pángbiān.
examples.english: Please sit beside me.

examples.pinyin: Bié jīdòng, mànmàn shuō.
examples.english: Don't get excited, speak slowly.

examples.hanzi: 看到老朋友，他激动得说不出话。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào lǎo péngyou, tā jīdòng de shuō bu chū huà.
examples.english: Seeing his old friend, he was too moved to speak.

examples.hanzi: 我为我的家乡感到骄傲。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wèi wǒ de jiāxiāng gǎndào jiāo'ào.
examples.english: I feel proud of my hometown.

examples.hanzi: 取得好成绩后不要骄傲。
examples.pinyin: Qǔdé hǎo chéngjì hòu búyào jiāo'ào.
examples.english: Don't get arrogant after getting good grades.

examples.hanzi: 我不想去，而是想在家休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng qù, ér shì xiǎng zài jiā xiūxi.
examples.english: I don't want to go, but rather want to rest at home.

examples.pinyin: Wèntí bú zài tā, ér shì zài wǒ.
examples.english: The problem isn't him, it's me.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiā yǒu sì ge chéngyuán.
examples.english: There are four members in our family.

examples.hanzi: 新成员明天会加入我们。
examples.pinyin: Xīn chéngyuán míngtiān huì jiārù wǒmen.
examples.english: The new member will join us tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 商店里装了摄像头来监视小偷。
examples.pinyin: Shāngdiàn lǐ zhuāngle shèxiàngtóu lái jiānshì xiǎotōu.
examples.english: The shop installed cameras to keep watch on thieves.

examples.hanzi: 护士在监视病人的情况。
examples.pinyin: Hùshi zài jiānshì bìngrén de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: The nurse is monitoring the patient's condition.

examples.hanzi: 这位女性是我们的经理。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi nǚxìng shì wǒmen de jīnglǐ.
examples.english: This woman is our manager.

examples.hanzi: 现在越来越多的女性出来工作。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài yuè lái yuè duō de nǚxìng chūlái gōngzuò.
examples.english: Nowadays more and more women go out to work.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu quánlì bǎochí chénmò.
examples.english: You have the right to remain silent.

examples.hanzi: 这是我们的权利，也是我们的责任。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒmen de quánlì, yě shì wǒmen de zérèn.
examples.english: This is both our right and our duty.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú huì duì nǐ shuōhuǎng.
examples.english: I won't lie to you.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuǎng de shíhou, liǎn huì hóng.
examples.english: His face turns red when he lies.

examples.pinyin: Shèngdàn jié nǐ yào zuò shénme?
examples.english: What will you do at Christmas?

examples.hanzi: 商店里挂满了圣诞礼物。
examples.pinyin: Shāngdiàn lǐ guàmǎnle shèngdàn lǐwù.
examples.english: The shops are full of Christmas gifts.

examples.hanzi: 这位黑人歌手唱歌特别好听。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi hēirén gēshǒu chànggē tèbié hǎotīng.
examples.english: This singer sings especially beautifully.

examples.hanzi: 他对隔壁新来的黑人邻居很友好。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì gébì xīn lái de hēirén línjū hěn yǒuhǎo.
examples.english: He is friendly to the new neighbor next door.

examples.hanzi: 警方提醒市民注意安全。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng tíxǐng shìmín zhùyì ānquán.
examples.english: The police reminded citizens to be careful.

examples.hanzi: 警方已经找到了失踪的小孩。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng yǐjīng zhǎodàole shīzōng de xiǎohái.
examples.english: The police have found the missing child.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ qùguo Fǎguó liǎng cì.
examples.english: I have been to France twice.

examples.pinyin: Fǎguó de miànbāo hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: French bread is delicious.

examples.pinyin: Bié cuòguò zhè ge hǎo jīhuì.
examples.english: Don't miss this great chance.

examples.hanzi: 他错过了最后一班地铁。
examples.pinyin: Tā cuòguòle zuìhòu yì bān dìtiě.
examples.english: He missed the last subway.

examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jǐnggào wǒ búyào áoyè.
examples.english: The doctor warned me not to stay up late.

examples.hanzi: 警察向司机发出了警告。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá xiàng sījī fāchūle jǐnggào.
examples.english: The police issued a warning to the driver.

examples.pinyin: Lǎotiān bǎoyòu nǐ!
examples.english: May Heaven protect you!

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de lǎotiān, zhème duō rén!
examples.english: Good heavens, so many people!

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔdiàn lí jīchǎng hěn jìn.
examples.english: This hotel is very close to the airport.

examples.pinyin: Jiǔdiàn de zǎocān hěn fēngfù.
examples.english: The hotel's breakfast is very rich.

examples.hanzi: 我喜欢运动，像游泳、跑步之类的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan yùndòng, xiàng yóuyǒng, pǎobù zhīlèi de.
examples.english: I like sports, things like swimming and running.

examples.hanzi: 你可以买些书之类的做礼物。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ mǎi xiē shū zhīlèi de zuò lǐwù.
examples.english: You can buy some books or the like as a gift.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen duì déle guànjūn!
examples.english: Our team won the championship!

examples.pinyin: Tā shì shìjiè guànjūn.
examples.english: He is a world champion.

examples.hanzi: 你可以尝试用不同的方法。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ chángshì yòng bùtóng de fāngfǎ.
examples.english: You can try using a different method.

examples.hanzi: 我想尝试一下新的工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chángshì yíxià xīn de gōngzuò.
examples.english: I'd like to give a new job a try.

examples.pinyin: Jiàoliàn dài wǒmen liànxí yóuyǒng.
examples.english: The coach takes us to practice swimming.

examples.pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào dāng zúqiú jiàoliàn.
examples.english: He works as a soccer coach at the school.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ tīngting duìfāng de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: Please listen to the other side's thoughts.

examples.pinyin: Duìfāng méiyǒu jiē diànhuà.
examples.english: The other person didn't answer the phone.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ suíshí lái zhǎo wǒ.
examples.english: You can come to me at any time.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen suíshí zhǔnbèi chūfā.
examples.english: We are ready to set off at any moment.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bú shì dírén, shì péngyou.
examples.english: We're not enemies, we're friends.

examples.hanzi: 电影里的敌人最后投降了。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng lǐ de dírén zuìhòu tóuxiáng le.
examples.english: The enemy in the movie finally surrendered.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào yí ge hǎo dādàng.
examples.english: I need a good partner.

examples.hanzi: 他们搭档做生意已经十年了。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen dādàng zuò shēngyi yǐjīng shí nián le.
examples.english: They have been partners in business for ten years.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóngwèi qùguo Běijīng.
examples.english: I've never been to Beijing.

examples.pinyin: Tā cóngwèi duì wǒ fāguo píqi.
examples.english: He has never lost his temper with me.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiǎng hé wǒ tánhuà.
examples.english: The teacher wants to talk to me.

examples.hanzi: 我们的谈话持续了一个小时。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de tánhuà chíxùle yí ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Our conversation lasted an hour.

examples.pinyin: Yuēhàn shì yì míng Yīngyǔ lǎoshī.
examples.english: John is an English teacher.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ rènshi Yuēhàn ma?
examples.english: Do you know John?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu xǔduō péngyou.
examples.english: I have a lot of friends.

examples.hanzi: 许多人喜欢在周末睡懒觉。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō rén xǐhuan zài zhōumò shuì lǎnjiào.
examples.english: Many people like to sleep in on weekends.

examples.hanzi: 他是历史上的重要人物。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì lìshǐ shàng de zhòngyào rénwù.
examples.english: He is an important figure in history.

examples.hanzi: 这个故事里有三个主要人物。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge gùshi lǐ yǒu sān ge zhǔyào rénwù.
examples.english: There are three main characters in this story.

examples.pinyin: Tóur ràng wǒmen xiān kāihuì.
examples.english: The boss told us to hold a meeting first.

examples.pinyin: Nǐmen tóur zài nǎr?
examples.english: Where is your leader?

examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé jiàozuò Huáng Hé.
examples.english: This river is called the Yellow River.

examples.hanzi: 你为什么把他叫做哥哥？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme bǎ tā jiàozuò gēge?
examples.english: Why do you call him older brother?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn gǎnjī lǎoshī de bāngzhù.
examples.english: I'm very grateful for the teacher's help.

examples.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ, wǒ yǒngyuǎn gǎnjī nǐ.
examples.english: Thank you, I'll be grateful to you forever.

examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó de Chūnjié hěn rènao.
examples.english: Spring Festival in China is very lively.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xué Zhōngguó cài.
examples.english: I want to learn to cook Chinese food.

examples.hanzi: 我想吃一块巧克力蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chī yí kuài qiǎokèlì dàngāo.
examples.english: I'd like to eat a piece of chocolate cake.

examples.hanzi: 妈妈给我做了一个生日蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Māma gěi wǒ zuòle yí ge shēngrì dàngāo.
examples.english: Mom made me a birthday cake.

examples.pinyin: Gōngzuò hěn shùnlì.
examples.english: Work is going smoothly.

examples.pinyin: Zhù nǐ yílù shùnlì!
examples.english: Wishing you a smooth journey!
